Maria Kawamura (Japanese: 川村万梨阿 Kawamura Maria) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Kawamura was born as Shigeyo Kawamura (川村繁代 Kawamura Shigeyo) on November 21, 1961, in , , , and became a voice actress as an adult. Kawamura has had various roles throughout , including the voice of Elite Four member Lorelei (Prima). Her most recent role was that of Fennel during . She was once affiliated with , but is now freelancing. She married manga artist on November 8, 1991.
